Marisol repeatedly treats ORD as preferable and uses MDW only for meaningful savings; Southwest saves only $28 while requiring Midway and returning more than two hours later. Delta saves only $22 but adds an unnecessary connection and a much later arrival. United is a soft preference when comparable, not enough to overcome American's better price and timing here.
